$sources: NBC 105:2020 (Seismic Design of Buildings in Nepal) Sections 3-6: soil types A-D, the spectral shape factor Ch(T), the elastic site spectrum C(T) = Ch(T) Z I, the ULS design spectrum Cd(T) = C(T) / (Rμ Ωu), the period T1 = 1.25 kt H^(3/4), the equivalent static method, the drift limit; see VERIFY.md
source: NBC 105:2020: C(T) = Ch(T) Z I with Ch(T) of the soil type (Table 4-1: Ta, Tc, α, K), Z the seismic zoning factor of the municipality (0.25-0.40) and I the importance factor; the ULS design spectrum Cd(T) = C(T) / (Rμ Ωu) by the system (Rμ, Ωu: R holds the product, Rd = Rμ, Ro = Ωu; Cd = Rμ for the ULS deflections); the equivalent static method takes α below Ta. The SLS spectrum (0.2 C(T) / Ωs) and its drift check are not built (the ULS drift governs for the usual Ωu / Ωs, VERIFY.md N12). Entered from knowledge of the code, every value to be checked against the printed code (VERIFY.md).

A.description: Soil type A: stiff and hard soil sites (rock, or stiff soil less than 6 m over rock; Ta 0.11 s, Tc 0.5 s)

B.description: Soil type B: medium soil sites (Ta 0.11 s, Tc 0.7 s)

C.description: Soil type C: soft soil sites (deep alluvium; Ta 0.11 s, Tc 1.0 s)

D.description: Soil type D: very soft soil sites (Ta 0.5 s, Tc 2.0 s)

clauses.performance: NBC 105:2020 5.3 (Rμ Ωu as the system's R; no Sp)

clauses.static: NBC 105:2020 6.1.2 (α below Ta for the equivalent static method)

rcDualSpecial.name: RC dual system (moment frame and structural walls)

masonryOrdinaryPlain.name: Unreinforced masonry walls with RC bands

generatorSystems.$comment: SAEngine practice: the New Building generator's steel systems of NBC 105:2020 Table 5-2

allowableDriftLabel: Ultimate limit state inter-storey deflection (Rμ × the deflection of Cd(T))

clauses.scale: NBC 105:2020 Section 7 (modal base shear scaled to the equivalent static one; check the subclause)
clauses.modes: NBC 105:2020 Section 7 (90 % of the mass; check the subclause)
clauses.displacement: NBC 105:2020 6.5 (Rμ × the elastic deflections of Cd(T))
clauses.weight: NBC 105:2020 5.2 (DL + λ LL, λ = 0.3; 0.6 for storage)

sources.siteClasses: NBC 105:2020 4.1.3 (soil types A-D by their description, SPT and shear wave speed) and Table 4-1: Ta 0.11, 0.11, 0.11, 0.5 s; Tc 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 2.0 s; α 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.25; K 1.8, 1.8, 1.8, 0.8. Ch(T) = 1 + (α - 1) T/Ta below Ta (modal; α for the equivalent static method), α to Tc, α [K + (1 - K)(Tc/T)²](Tc/T)² beyond (Eq 4.1(1) as SAEngine read it, uncertain: VERIFY.md N2), held beyond 6 s
sources.systems: NBC 105:2020 Table 5-2: ductility factor Rμ (Rd) and overstrength factor Ωu (Ro), R = Rμ Ωu; Cd = Rμ (6.5); Omega0 holds Ωu (uncertain values: VERIFY.md N5)
sources.periodCoefficients: NBC 105:2020 5.1.2: T1 = 1.25 kt H^(3/4), kt = 0.075 RC moment frames, 0.085 steel moment frames, 0.075 eccentrically braced steel frames, 0.05 all others (Ct holds 1.25 kt)
sources.designCategories: SAEngine practice: Z is 0.25-0.40 everywhere in Nepal and NBC 105:2020 asks for ductile detailing in all of it: one category (D)
sources.liveShare: NBC 105:2020 5.2, Table 5-1: λ = 0.3 (0.6 for storage: enter as a Code Value)
sources.torsionIrregular: NBC 105:2020 5.5.2 (torsional irregularity: the largest drift over 1.5 × the average; check)
sources.minimumScale: SAEngine practice (the modal base shear not below the equivalent static one, on the safe side; check NBC 105:2020 7)
sources.pgaFactor: NBC 105:2020 4.1: Z is the peak ground acceleration (S = 1)
sources.verticalFactor: NBC 105:2020 4.3: the vertical spectrum Cv = (2/3) Z (uncertain)
